verdict.rationale: Browserbase publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.0 "Browserbase API" spec at /reference/api/openapi.v1.yaml, served at api.browserbase.com. Its generated API reference pages include a live "Try it" playground, and an official SDK lets users create, control, and observe sessions programmatically. The 404s on the conventional OpenAPI paths only show the spec lives at a different path, not that it is missing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of actually driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: docs.browserbase.com publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document whose info block reads "title: Browserbase API" and "description: Browserbase API for 3rd party developers", version v1, server url https://api.browserbase.com.
The "Create a Session" API reference page renders a live "Try it" API playground (the Mintlify api.playground runtime) with a runnable request to https://api.browserbase.com/v1/sessions.
Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.

the official `@browserbasehq/sdk` package is the easiest way
to connect to and control headless browsers running on Browserbase.
